S00.name: Hero
S00.last_diagnosis: Visual research/program loop A-H resolved the core rendering direction. COBE's opaque base sphere is incompatible with the reference's transparent point-world grammar and transparent base color remains unsupported upstream. GitHub's published Three.js globe architecture was prototyped successfully: transparent canvas, depth-only sphere, world land as fine points, and the situated territory as a brighter same-sphere point cloud. Prototypes G/H remove the opaque-disc failure and restore the baseline hierarchy; remaining risk is technical productization and editorial craft, so Three.js bundle/load/fallback/performance now require formal tech research before production BUILD.
